run_NNFMLoss_forward: run NNFMLoss forward pass to compute nnfm, content, and gram losses from output, style, and content images
create_NNFMLoss_instance: create an NNFMLoss instance with a pretrained VGG-16 model on the specified device for feature extraction
run_match_colors_for_image_set: run match_colors_for_image_set to transform an image set colors to match a style image using SVD
run_nn_feat_replace: run nn_feat_replace to replace features in tensor a with nearest neighbors from tensor b by cosine distance
run_gram_matrix: run gram_matrix to compute the Gram matrix of feature maps for style loss computation
